latest.headline: CPI at 7:30 SK decides whether Monday's chip rebound holds
latest.tldr: Chips had their best day in months on Monday (SOX about +6.9%, MU +6.25% to $733.15) and Asia followed, but Nasdaq 100 futures are −0.3% and MU has faded to about $726 ahead of an 8:30 ET CPI print that a Fed governor has tied to a possible 50bp December hike.
